Original lawful test publications, generated by the project's `readingtest` fixture writer at db54b84e422aafa4f8c6326e60a575d893d26b6d before the old server was removed. No third-party content or encoder was used. Two original PNG pages; stored RAR5, stored RAR4, literal-only RAR 2.9 compressed and solid continuations, and a plain-header stored 7z container. ComicInfo.xml (except the two compressed RAR4 cases) sets right-to-left reading.

`encoded.cb7` holds the same three members as `comic.cb7`, repacked on 16 Nov 2026 with 7-Zip 23.01 at its default settings (`7zz a encoded.cb7 ComicInfo.xml page1.png page2.png`), which compress the archive header.
